headline: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Bolt models for multimodal agents and local deployment
summary: NVIDIA announced Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, a 120B open model for multimodal agent tasks, alongside Bolt 74B-A9B targeted at 24GB local deployment and Bolt E4B for 4GB devices. NVIDIA's Oct. 15 account said E4B was scheduled for Oct. 23.
